text:
We just had our appointment last week in the Ramat Gan branch. We had printed copies of everything we had uploaded during the applications, but they only took the copies of the documents: birth certificate, criminal background, personal status. But seems good to have it all printed just in case.

For us it took 12 days from the moment we sent in the application to get a request for an additional document, and then one more day until we got an appointment to show the originals and a different date (January) for the interview.
